value.title: Compare incident-summary prompt variants
value.task: Read incident.txt. Write a customer-facing incident summary to answer.md in at most 100 words. Include the impact, recovery, what is known versus unknown, and a next investigation step. Do not modify incident.txt.

files.incident.txt:
Incident notes
12:00 UTC: elevated errors began after deployment D42.
12:14 UTC: service recovered after rollback.
120 requests failed during the interruption.
Root cause: not yet established.
Data loss: not yet assessed.

criteria.description: Reports the 14-minute interruption and 120 affected requests from incident.txt, without inventing a root cause or asserting that data was lost.
Explicitly distinguishes the observed recovery after rollback from the still-unknown root cause and unknown data-loss status.
The answer is at most 100 words, understandable, and includes a concrete next investigation step.

value.title: Evidence and uncertainty prompt
value.prompt: Ground every factual claim in the provided evidence. Separate observations from hypotheses and unknowns. Do not infer causation from a temporal sequence. Include a concrete next investigation step. Review your answer for unsupported claims before finishing.
